description.value: Saigon Char-Broil is a Vietnamese restaurant group with three locations across Victoria, serving pho, vermicelli bowls, salad rolls, and charbroiled rice dishes. The Esquimalt location is a standalone dine-in restaurant at the corner of Esquimalt Road and Fraser Street, while the Hillside and Tillicum locations operate as food-court counters inside their respective malls. All three locations offer takeout, including through third-party delivery apps.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 32m; rack at 41m; rack at 51m; rack at 55m; floor (covered) at 62m.

Takeout is explicitly offered at all locations per the website; vegetarian options ('Tofu & Veggie', 'Vegetarian spring rolls are also available') appear throughout the menus.
